verdict.rationale: Square's official Mobile Payments SDK is documented for accepting in-person payments in both iOS and Android apps. Platform-specific docs cover Tap to Pay on iPhone without extra hardware and offline payments on Android. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK integration, and deeper evidence of integration details such as reader pairing and Android contactless parity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed in-person payments into my own iOS or Android app with official mobile SDKs

citations.quote: Use the Mobile Payments SDK to accept in-person payments in iOS and Android
Accept contactless payments with your iPhone and the Mobile Payments SDK without additional hardware.
Learn how to take offline payments with the Mobile Payments SDK for Android.
